compiled_state.title: Story-level integration gate: all DDs pass together on merged branch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing (holistic — confirms tasks 1-5 produce a coherent green branch)

## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] All five prior-task test files pass in a single pytest invocation (story-level RED→GREEN gate)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_config.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_exceptions.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_status_preflight.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_purity_status.py
- [ ] No regressions in existing reconciler test suite
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/

## Implementation Notes
This task is a no-code holistic verification step. It dispatches no edits; it simply runs the full prior-task test set in one pytest invocation on the merged branch and confirms green. Closure of this task is the story's final RED→GREEN transition.

If any prior-task test fails here that passed in isolation, that signals an inter-task contract violation — diagnose and either amend the offending task or open a follow-up bug ticket.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
